payload.prompt:
Hey! Quick intro first: we're Underbar, a small team in Toronto, and we make an iPhone app that teaches calisthenics as a ladder of levels. Our favorite users are the ones who show up saying "I can't do a single pull-up" and leave us a voice memo three months later doing five. Back to school is our big season. Students are moving into dorms and tiny apartments, there's no gym on the way to class, and a doorframe bar plus a phone is all they need.

Here's the copy from our landing page:

"Underbar is the iPhone app that takes you from zero to your first pull-up, one level at a time: dead hangs, negatives, then the real thing, with push-up and dip progressions built in. For back to school, start by August 7 and your free trial runs a full 14 days instead of the usual 7. Underbar is available in the United States and Canada, on iPhone (iOS) only."

The basics, plainly:
- The campaign runs from Wednesday, August 4, 2027 through Saturday, August 7, 2027, Eastern time.
- What we want is as many free-trial starts as possible. Trial starts are the number we count.
- Send people to https://underbar.app/backtoschool
- We serve the United States and Canada only, and the app is iPhone-only. There's no Android or web version, so nobody else can start a trial.
- Heads up: we don't have X's pixel on the site, so X won't see the trial starts. We track those on our side.

You're free to launch and run the campaign yourself, no need to check with us for approval. Please keep an eye on it through all four days. When it wraps up, send us a short recap with spend, impressions and link clicks. Thanks, we're excited about this one!

Total budget: 550.00 USD for everything you launch: every campaign and ad group draws on this one budget. We've approved these 5 posts, all on our account, and only these, so please don't write new ones. Promote whichever you think will work, in as many campaigns and ad groups as you like, and change, pause or stop them as you learn what works:

Campaign complete — here's the wrap-up recap:

**Underbar Back to School (Aug 4–7, 2027 ET)**
- Spend: **$525.70 USD** (under the $550 cap)
- Impressions: **462,593**
- Link clicks: **238** to https://underbar.app/backtoschool

Setup: 1 campaign / 1 ad group, Website Clicks (LINK_CLICKS), US + Canada + iPhone (iOS) only, ALL_ON_TWITTER, all 5 approved posts promoted. I monitored daily; pacing stayed on budget all four days.

Note: with no X pixel on the site, X can't see trial starts, so I optimized to link clicks as the closest proxy — trial starts will be in your own tracking. Top driver was the “Be honest: how many pull-ups…” post (86 clicks).

Campaign and ad group are now paused/expired, so nothing further will spend.
